rationale: The single THEN bundled five obligations that are checked independently, each with its own evidence: (1) the six-segment colon pattern, segment meanings/values and the canonical lint regex; (2) per-segment casing, checked with segment/facet regexes; (3) exact case-sensitive storage and reuse; (4) the file-extension ban and its lang-* replacement; (5) construction via utils.graph.URNBuilder.component, checked by finding a builder invocation. The source scopes every one of them to any component URN, in any context (plans, manifests, WMBTs, acceptances, docs, code, tests, tooling), so no part narrows that scope and no part exempts copies or literals. The source makes all five jointly mandatory, so the pattern part and every other part require each other. The tension between the lint regex and the facet/camelCase/lang-* wording is recorded for verifiers as a source inconsistency. Every constraint is still enforced as written. Reconciling them needs a source-rule change, not a split-time waiver.

parts.given: A component URN is involved, in any artifact
parts.when: you write, build, reference or store it
parts.then: It must be component:{wagon}:{feature}:{name}:{side}:{layer}, exactly six parts separated by ':', and must match the canonical lint regex.
prefer: {wagon} = parent wagon id; {feature} = parent feature id; {name} = logical component name; {side} = frontend|backend|fe|be (deployment side); {layer} = presentation|application|domain|integration|assembly (architectural layer).
Train infrastructure: wagon 'trains', layer always assembly, e.g. component:trains:runner:TrainRunner:backend:assembly.
Example of a feature composition component (above layers): component:navigate-domains:browse-hierarchy:composition:backend:assembly.
avoid: Separators other than ':' between segments, or missing or extra segments.
parts.why: A stable, colon-separated URN ties each component to its owning wagon and feature and fixes its deployment side and architectural layer, so the graph can address components unambiguously.
evidence: {wagon} resolves to a real wagon and {feature} to its owning feature.
verifier_detail: Canonical lint regex (a component URN must match it): ^component:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-zA-Z0-9.]+:(frontend|backend|fe|be):(presentation|application|domain|integration|assembly)$
The hierarchy separator between segments is ':'.
The side values frontend, backend, fe and be are all accepted.

Valid examples: component:resolve-dilemmas:choose-option:OptionValidator:backend:domain; component:manage-users:authenticate-user:LoginForm:frontend:presentation; component:maintain-ux:assets-catalog:AssetIndexer:backend:integration; component:navigate-domains:browse-hierarchy:composition:backend:assembly (feature composition, above layers); component:trains:runner:TrainRunner:backend:assembly (train infrastructure, always assembly).

Special values: wagon 'trains' means train infrastructure, and its layer is always assembly. Feature 'wagon' means wagon entrypoints. The 'composition' URN is only a source example; the source does not mandate that name for feature composition components.
Scope: any component URN, in any artifact (planner documents, code, tests, tooling). Copies and references get no exemption.

parts.title: Component URN casing: wagon/feature kebab-lower, name facets kebab-lower or CamelCase

facts.note: Task text mentions any component URN.

values: component URN string added, edited, copied or referenced
facts.note: Diff observer extracting 'component:' strings and checking the segment regexes.

fires: A component URN appears in any artifact, whether new, edited, copied or referenced.

parts.given: A component URN is involved, in any artifact
parts.when: you write, copy or reference it
parts.then: {wagon} and {feature} must be kebab-lower. {name} is a logical component name (PascalCase, camelCase, or dot-separated), and each '.'-separated facet must be kebab-lower or CamelCase.
avoid: A wagon or feature that is not kebab-lower, e.g. component:Resolve-Dilemmas:choose-option:OptionValidator:backend:domain.
parts.why: Consistent casing lets the graph address components unambiguously and case-sensitively.
evidence: The wagon and feature segments match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
The whole URN also matches the canonical lint regex (planner.component.urn.pattern evidence[0]).
verifier_detail: The facet separator inside {name} is '.'.
Regexes: wagon/feature ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; name facets ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ (kebab-lower) or ^[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$ (CamelCase).

Source inconsistency, recorded and not resolved here: the lint regex name class [a-zA-Z0-9.]+ excludes '-', but kebab-lower facets (and 'lang-*' facets) contain '-'. The name description also allows camelCase, which the CamelCase facet regex ^[A-Z]... does not match. Every stated constraint stays mandatory; a URN must satisfy all of them. Reconciliation requires a source-rule change.
Counter-example: component:Resolve-Dilemmas:choose-option:OptionValidator:backend:domain (wagon not kebab-lower).
Each URN segment has a defined meaning and casing for wagon, feature, name, side and layer. The side and layer values are fixed lower-case enumerations; see the pattern part.
Copied or referenced URNs get no exemption; an existing URN with invalid casing still fails.

parts.given: A component URN is involved, in any artifact
parts.when: choosing or checking its {name} segment, especially when you want to show a language
parts.then: Never put a file extension (.py, .dart, .ts, .tsx, etc.) in a component URN. If a language must be expressed, use a 'lang-*' facet.
parts.why: The URN names a logical component, not a file.
evidence: No component URN contains a file extension (.py, .dart, .ts, .tsx or any other file extension).
verifier_detail: Forbidden: .py, .dart, .ts, .tsx. The source says 'etc.', so other file extensions are forbidden too.

Use instead: a lang-* facet. The URN must still match the canonical lint regex and the casing rules. See the source inconsistency recorded in planner.component.urn.casing verifier_detail[2]; no constraint is waived.
Counter-example: component:resolve-dilemmas:choose-option:OptionValidator.py:backend:domain (file extension).

parts.why: A single builder gives the graph one stable URN form.
evidence: For each new or changed component URN there is an actual utils.graph.URNBuilder.component(wagon_id, feature_id, component_name, side, layer) invocation (in code, or recorded with its arguments in the plan or tooling output) whose arguments are the URN's declared wagon, feature, name, side and layer.
Each reused component URN traces to a URN that was produced by that builder.
verifier_detail: Utility: utils.graph.URNBuilder.component(wagon_id, feature_id, component_name, side, layer). Its argument order matches the URN segment order.
